Why Choose Buture VAC01 Cordless Vacuum Cleaner?

Incredible and Uninterrupted Cleaning

Powered with high-performance 600W motor to provide accelerated 50kPA suction, the Buture VAC01 Vacuum Cleaner effortlessly lifts surface debris and embedded dirt, outperforming 95% of vacuums on the market, making it ideal for both carpets and hard floors. Enjoy an uninterrupted cleaning routine with its 8-cell lithium battery when ridding your home of various hair, dirt, and other messes.

Benefits:

  • Exceptional Suction Power: Tackles stubborn dirt and pet hair with ease, ensuring a thorough clean.

  • Versatile Cleaning: Suitable for all types of surfaces, from carpets to hardwood floors.

  • Efficient Performance: Provides superior cleaning results, saving time and effort.

Self-Standing Design

The VAC01 features a self-standing design, allowing you to pause and resume cleaning without needing to lean the vacuum against a wall. This design ensures easy storage and access, making it perfect for quick clean-ups.

Benefits:

  • Hands-Free Use: Conveniently pauses and resumes cleaning without hassle.

  • Space-Saving Storage: Stand it upright anywhere in your home for easy access and storage.

  • Enhanced Stability: Reduces the risk of tipping over, ensuring safety and longevity.

Integrated Wall Charging Mount

The VAC01 comes with an integrated wall mount that functions as both a charging station and storage solution. Charge your vacuum quickly and keep accessories organized, or remove the battery for separate charging if preferred.

Benefits:

  • Convenient Charging: Wall mount charges the vacuum and stores accessories, ready for the next use.

  • Flexible Charging Options: Remove the battery for separate charging if needed.

  • Organized Storage: Keep your cleaning tools neatly arranged and accessible.

Smart Touch Screen with 4 Cleaning Modes

The intuitive smart touch screen allows easy mode selection with a simple touch. Choose from ECO, STANDARD, BOOST, or AUTO modes to suit different cleaning tasks and floor types. AUTO mode adjusts suction power automatically for optimal performance.

Modes:

  1. BOOST Mode: 50kPa for deep cleaning carpets and removing pet hair.

  2. STANDARD Mode: 30kPa for routine cleaning tasks on various surfaces.

  3. ECO Mode: 18kPa for light cleaning and energy conservation.

Advanced Multi-Layer Filtration System

The VAC01 features a sophisticated multi-layer filtration system to ensure a clean and allergen-free environment. The system includes a stainless steel filter, HEPA filter, sponge filter, and more to capture particles of all sizes.

  • Stainless Steel Filter: Captures large debris and hair.

  • HEPA Filter: Traps fine dust and allergens for cleaner air.

  • Sponge Filter: Adds an extra layer of dust capture.

  • Motor Air Cooling Filter: Protects the motor for consistent performance.

  • Dust Cup: Holds and collects dust and debris efficiently.
